question: Will Apple be the third-largest company in the world by market cap on July 31?
rules:
This market will resolve to the third-largest company in the world by market cap on July 31, 2026, as of market close.

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

evidence.excerpt: Apple was last valued at $4.90 trillion as its shares rose marginally in premarket trading on Friday, while Nvidia was roughly at the same level, following a 2.4% decline. Apple had raised prices to offset rising costs, a strategy that could hurt demand.

The Google parent, the third-largest U.S. company by market value at $4.2 trillion, can jostle indexes as one of the heavyweight "Magnificent Seven" stocks. Alphabet and Intel were set to offer updates in the coming week that could sway the market-leading AI trade.

China's cyberspace regulator said on Wednesday that Apple's on-device generative AI service, Apple Intelligence, has been registered for use on iPhones in China, paving the way for the long-anticipated rollout of the service in the country.

BEIJING, July 7 (Reuters) - Smartphone sales in China fell 13% year-on-year during the month-long 618 shopping festival, as brands raised prices to offset higher memory costs, according to data from Counterpoint Research. Apple's sales remained lower than a year earlier.

The Company posted quarterly revenue of $111.2 billion, up 17 percent year over year. Diluted earnings per share was $2.01, up 22 percent year over year. The board of directors has also authorized an additional program to repurchase up to $100 billion of the Company's common stock.
